name: Lunhui
source:
The game's protagonist, Liya, works as an actor after a difficult phase of his life begins a quest for fame. But while facing a variety of new people and obstacles, can he change his rebellious nature and become a famous star? Or will he become an unknown newcomer who is a stepping stone for others? Or does he find his love and have a romance? Or will his girlfriend leave him, despite his tears streaming down his face?
Under the scrutiny of his ex-girlfriend, what is Liya's fate?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/663060/]Steam[/url]]
